signs.name: Red ring
signs.means: The skater you control. The tick on the ring points the way he faces, which is where a shot or pass will go.

signs.name: Blue double ring
signs.means: The skater the second player controls, when two play.

signs.name: Red arrow
signs.means: Whoever has the puck, on either team.

signs.name: Diamond
signs.means: The team-mate your pass would go to if you pressed pass now. Move the stick and it moves.

signs.name: Yellow bar
signs.means: A button being held. For shoot, the wind-up: full is the hardest shot. For pass, full is a saucer pass over sticks. For check, full is a body check and less is a poke.

signs.name: Thin red circle
signs.means: How far your poke check reaches. The puck must be inside it, and you must not be behind the carrier.

signs.name: Gold ring
signs.where: Round a team-mate, on the practice rink
signs.means: Your pass is on its way to him. Hold shoot before it arrives and he fires it first time: a one-timer. In the lessons, time runs slow while the ring is showing.

signs.name: Rising words
signs.means: White words name a move that has just come off: a steal, a big hit, a block, a one-timer. Yellow words are the name of one of your artifacts coming into force. With hints on, white words also say why a check or a one-timer of yours missed.

signs.name: Strip under a team's name
signs.means: Momentum. It fills with goals, big hits, one-timers, saves, blocks, steals and dekes that slip a check.

signs.name: The strip full and flashing
signs.means: That team is on fire: for a short time its skaters are faster and shoot harder.

signs.name: Dots under the clock
signs.means: The periods: filled for the ones played and the one being played.

signs.name: Bars, bottom left
signs.means: The top bar is your skater's sprint. Below it, the energy of each of your two lines: the ringed one is on the ice. A tired line skates and checks worse; press line change, or let the bench do it.

signs.name: A boss: heavy pale ring
signs.means: He cannot be knocked down and shakes off a hit at once. Poke the puck off him.

signs.name: A boss: pale bar beside a skater
signs.means: He blocks shots standing up while the bar shows. Pass round him or move before you shoot.

signs.name: A boss: flashing orange circle
signs.means: He is winding up a hit that will put you on the ice. Pass, or deke as he arrives.

signs.name: A boss: faint lines from the carrier
signs.means: His passes cannot be picked off in the lane. Cover the man the pass is going to.
